Created by {{player|qurnel|flag=pl}} way back in time, the map features long open rooms with a circular playstyle. 

Note that rwild '''does not''' feature [[LG]]. 

rwild has been the featured map in both [[King of Tuesday Kenya 9]] who played out 29 May 2007, and [[Qwenya]] Season 2.
